arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

8000 m, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Settle after the hard start to about sustainable pace (pod near 167-175 W). Hold even effort near critical power through the middle; compare legs in the same direction to separate current from fatigue. Watch for anything that slows the boat while pod power holds (rudder weed, drag, wind) and for pod drift (pod and boat-model power disagreeing). Final push from about 1000-1500 m left if reserve allows; finish sprint last 300-400 m.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: GPS speed shortfall vs pod power, net of fitted current; strongly negative = extra drag (weed, rudder) or pod reading high

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power predicts beyond current: check weed/rudder drag vs pod drift (compare speed_gps vs shaft_power).
Boat faster than pod predicts: pod reading low, or new tailwind/current.
Pod reserve below 30 percent: check whether there is enough distance left; ease if far from finish.
Pod power well below critical power for a minute: paddler fading, blowing up, or pod drifting.

arguments.reason: Check the paddler settled after the start cue.

arguments.text: Min 1: start hard (boat 143 W vs CP 108, pod 216 vs 167, pod reserve 75 pct). Cued ease to 163 s/500. Watches: extra_drag (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.2 for 40 s), pod_low_or_tailwind (> 0.3 for 60 s), reserve_low_early (pod reserve < 30 pct), power_drop (pod < 85 pct CP for 60 s). At min 1 push_local was already +0.2-0.26 with push_along about 0 (eta estimate may still be settling).

text: Cued ease to 163 s/500 to settle after a hard start; set plan, drag/pod/reserve watches and a 2-minute check.

arguments.text: Too hot for eight k. Ease to 165 pace and hold it.

arguments.reason: Check whether the ease to 165 took; pod reserve was 40 pct at min 3.2.

text: Cued ease to 165 s/500: pod reserve 40 pct at min 3, still 13 pct over critical power; check in 90 s.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 15 pct with more than 1500 m to go: ease to protect from blow-up.
Pod power 8 pct over sustainable for a minute: paddler drifting hot.
Pod power 8 pct under sustainable for 90 s: paddler drifting slow (or pod drift).

arguments.text: Min 4.7: second ease cue took; pod 173 W vs sustainable 168, boat 109 vs CP 108, pod reserve 31 pct (spent in hard start). Hold sustainable now. Watches changed: reserve_low_early now pod reserve < 15 pct with > 1500 m left; too_hot (pod > 108 pct sustainable 60 s); too_slow (pod < 92 pct sustainable 90 s).

text: no cue: paddler settled at sustainable power; retuned reserve watch and added too_hot / too_slow pacing watches.

arguments.text: Ease a touch to 166. Long way, smooth and relaxed.

Min 7.7 (leg 2, heading south): drifted hot again, pod 180 W vs sustainable 168, pod reserve 15 pct, boat reserve 22 pct. Paddler says 9/10, hurting, not sure can hold. Consistent with CP calibration roughly right. Cued ease to 166. Do not let them run the reserve empty mid-race.

arguments.reason: Check ease to 166 took and reserve is no longer draining.
